extracted.intended_audience: students, scholars, and general readers of early-modern literature and utopian fiction (readers of Francis Bacon's New Atlantis)
extracted.subtask_description: A prose excerpt from Francis Bacon's New Atlantis describing social institutions (Salomon's House, family feasts, marriage customs) and the scientific installations of the imagined commonwealth. Useful for literary study, close reading, or historical/contextual analysis of early-modern utopian writing.
